PhD and MPhil in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
The PhD and MPhil programmes in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DSAI) offer a rigorous and innovative academic environment for aspiring researchers. These programmes are designed to equip students with advanced knowledge and skills in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, fostering critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, allowing them to engage in groundbreaking research that addresses real-world challenges. Please click here for more details on the research areas.
The research interests of our individual academic staff can be found at Academic Staff . Contact our staff directly to discuss research opportunities.
Main research areas for PhD study
Machine Learning
Biometrics and Human Language Processing
Computer Vision and Graphics
Data Technologies and Governance
Statistical Learning and Optimization Methods
AI + X (Science, Healthcare, Neuroscience, etc.)
Research Studentships
PolyU offers Research Studentships to full-time PhD or MPhil students. The Studentship is a scholarship intended to be a means of financial support to allow full-time research students to fully focus on their studies. It shall be awarded on the basis of academic merit. The period of the Studentship is decided by the Department according to the student’s ability, academic background or experience.
